Resend

Send useful product messages from verified application events.

ROfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Resend is an email platform with developer APIs, transactional messaging, and marketing broadcasts. We can connect a verified application event to a clear customer message, such as an enquiry acknowledgement, account invitation, or billing update. The work includes the sending domain, reviewed templates, event handling, and suppression behavior so email supports a coherent customer experience.

Useful outputs

  • Email integration and reviewed templates
  • Event processing and delivery visibility
  • Sending and incident handling instructions

Where we can apply it

  • Website enquiry: validated submission → acknowledgement → owner notification.
  • SaaS onboarding: approved invitation → product email → account activation.
  • Delivery operations: bounce event → suppression update → exception review.
01

Use case 1

Send enquiry confirmations and internal owner notifications from a website.

02

Use case 2

Deliver account invitations, onboarding messages, and product event emails.

03

Use case 3

Use delivery events to investigate bounces and maintain message suppression.

Inputs we need

  • Verified sending domain and authorized API access
  • Approved templates and message triggering rules
  • Recipient sources and suppression requirements

Delivery sequence

  • Verify the sending domain and configure protected credentials.
  • Build templates and trigger messages only from approved events.
  • Check delivery events, failed sends, and duplicate message prevention.

Expert review points

  • Review recipient consent and the purpose of each message.
  • Confirm secrets and recipient data remain outside client-side code.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
